automated.summary: verify.py is green across all three workspaces with the observability slice built: structural (build incl. contract+backend+frontend, dual-runtime, vendor integrity), typecheck, quality (ESLint + Prettier) and test (backend hermetic incl. the two new common/ tests + the frontend Vitest files + the quality-gate guard). The two task-required hermetic tests pass DB-free via configureApp()+app.init(): (1) a guarded 4xx (CSRF 403) AND an unhandled 500 both return the constitution-07 error envelope with every field populated and a generated correlationId, with no stack in the response outside environment=Local - proving the filter+middleware are installed; (2) the request and error log records share the request correlationId/requestId, carry every constitution-05 field, honor a valid inbound x-correlation-id and generate a UUID for an absent/invalid one. Observed log records show 4xx at debug and 5xx at error.
automated.pass_fail_summary: backend/src/common: 2 tests, 2 passed, 0 failed; verify.py: Verification passed
residual_risks: Error metrics (D-0018), non-Local centralized log transport (D-0019), and decorated Swagger error DTOs (D-0020) are deferred to the production pilot per decision 0013's PoC scope.
